[p][b][i][u]About this game:  [/u][/i][/b]Rat Quest is a game about a rat platforming up the level to get his sweet sweet cheese.  [/p][p]
[/p][p][b][i][u]Difficult platforming:[/u][/i][/b] [/p][p]The platforming in this game is very difficult! Every jump matters, if you fall, its right back to the bottom.
[/p][p]
[/p][p][b][i][u][strike]Not as it seems:
[/strike][/u][/i][/b] everytHing is finE, no reason to worry in the sLightest. very Pleasant game.[/p]
data.strSnippet: In this platformer, jumping will be your main mechanic as you climb the level, each jump matters, if you miss a jump, you have to restart. You may be small but so are the platforms.
